sections.heading: Apple Watch and the Environment
sections.source_text: See the Apple Watch Ultra 4 Product Environmental Report (PDF) - opens in a new tab

sections.heading: Progress toward Apple 2030
sections.source_text:
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritizing the use of recycled and renewable content and low‑carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment

sections.heading: Materials
sections.source_text:
Apple Watch Ultra 4 is made with 45% recycled content, 29 including:
100% recycled cobalt in the battery
100% recycled copper wire and recycled tungsten in the Taptic Engine
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
95% recycled lithium in the battery
80% recycled steel in the battery enclosure and Taptic Engine components
100% recycled titanium in the case

sections.heading: Energy
sections.source_text:
100% of manufacturing electricity for Apple Watch Ultra 4 is sourced from renewable electricity 31
100% of expected customer energy use matched with renewable electricity 32

sections.heading: Waste
sections.source_text: No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Program 33

sections.heading: Smarter chemistry 34
sections.source_text:
All of the materials used in Apple products, accessories, and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification (PDF) - opens in a new tab , which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest Environmental Progress Report (PDF) - opens in a new tab to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
